```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

rm(list = ls())

library(tidyverse)
library(here)

# Plasmid annotations on contigs shorter than this are discarded
min_plasmid_contig_length <- 5000
```

# Load data

```{r load data}
metadata <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "metadata.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r abricate}

read_abricate_file <- function(file) {

  sample_id <- basename(file) %>%
    str_remove("\\.abricate_.*\\.out$") %>%
    str_remove("\\.out$")

  x <- read_tsv(file,
    col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
    progress = FALSE)

  if (nrow(x) == 0) {return(tibble())}

  x %>%
    rename(contig_id = SEQUENCE, start = START, end = END, product = PRODUCT,
           resistance = RESISTANCE) %>%
    mutate(sample_id = sample_id,
           start = as.integer(start),
           end = as.integer(end),
           # ResFinder variant name, as in Data/Raw/Phenotypes/phenotypes.tsv (e.g. blaTEM-1B_1_AY458016)
           variant = paste(GENE, ACCESSION, sep = "_")) %>%
    select(sample_id, contig_id, start, end, product, variant, resistance)}

```

```{r abricate genes}
resfinder_files <- list.files(here("Data", "Raw", "Assembly", "Abricate_resfinder"),
  pattern = "abricate_resfinder\\.out$",
  full.names = TRUE)

amr_hits <- map_dfr(
  resfinder_files,
  read_abricate_file)

amr_hits <- amr_hits %>%
  transmute(sample_id = sample_id,
            contig_id = contig_id,
            AMR_start = start,
            AMR_end = end,
            AMR_gene = product,
            AMR_variant = variant,
            resistance = resistance) %>%
  filter(sample_id %in% metadata$sample_id) %>%
  distinct()
```

```{r kraken2}
kraken <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Raw", "Assembly", "Kraken2", "kraken2_all_samples.tsv"),
                   show_col_types = FALSE,
                   progress = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(taxid = str_extract(assigned_taxon,
                             "(?<=taxid )\\d+"),
         taxid = as.integer(taxid))  %>%
  select(sample_id,	contig_id, contig_length, taxid)

taxonkit <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Raw", "Assembly", "Kraken2", "taxonkit_results.tsv"),
                   show_col_types = FALSE,
                   progress = FALSE,
                   col_names = c("taxid",
                                 "domain",
                                 "phylum",
                                 "class",
                                 "order",
                                 "family",
                                 "genus",
                                 "species"))
kraken <- kraken %>%
  left_join(taxonkit %>% select(taxid, genus, species), by = "taxid")

```

```{r map}
map <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Raw", "Assembly", "MAP", "MAP_all_mobilome_annotations.tsv"),
                   show_col_types = FALSE,
                   progress = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(sample_id = sample_id,
            contig_id = contig_id,
            annotation_source = annotation_source,
            element_type = feature_type,
            element_start = start,
            element_end = end) %>%
  left_join(kraken %>% select(sample_id, contig_id, contig_length),
            by = c("sample_id", "contig_id")) %>%
  filter(!(element_type == "plasmid" & contig_length < min_plasmid_contig_length)) %>%
  distinct()
```

# Contig Master

One row per AMR hit. MGE information comes only from MAP and is summarised per contig.

```{r contig master}
contig_mge <- map %>%
  semi_join(amr_hits, by = c("sample_id", "contig_id")) %>%
  select(-contig_length) %>%
  arrange(sample_id, contig_id, element_start)

mge_by_contig <- contig_mge %>%
  group_by(sample_id, contig_id) %>%
  summarise(is_plasmid = any(element_type == "plasmid"),
            element_types = str_c(sort(unique(element_type)), collapse = ";"),
            .groups = "drop")

contig_master <- amr_hits %>%
  left_join(kraken, by = c("sample_id", "contig_id")) %>%
  left_join(mge_by_contig, by = c("sample_id", "contig_id")) %>%
  mutate(has_mobile_element = !is.na(element_types),
         is_plasmid = replace_na(is_plasmid, FALSE)) %>%
  relocate(contig_length, .after = contig_id)

cat("AMR hits:", nrow(contig_master),
    "| contigs:", nrow(distinct(contig_master, sample_id, contig_id)),
    "| without Kraken2 length:", sum(is.na(contig_master$contig_length)), "\n")
```

```{r save}
write_tsv(contig_master, here("Data", "Processed", "contig_master.tsv"))
write_tsv(contig_mge, here("Data", "Processed", "contig_mge.tsv"))
```
